name: Mitten Extracts 510 Cartridge | Blueberry Pie
description: Enjoy the comforting flavor of warm blueberry pie, blending ripe blueberries with buttery pastry and a hint of sweet vanilla. Crafted with premium distillate and flavorful terpenes, this 2g cartridge delivers a smooth, dessert-inspired experience from the first draw to the last.
